summary: Local kayaker Cole Brunner, 31, caught in the "speed trap" hydraulic between the 8-foot and 23-foot drops on Oh Be Joyful Creek during a practice lap for the OBJ Steep Creek Race; fellow kayakers pulled him from the creek unconscious with no vital signs and performed CPR, led by fellow paddler Carl Anderson (ICU nurse). 911 call ~3 p.m.; Crested Butte SAR + Crested Butte Fire/EMS + Mt. Crested Butte police responded; CBSAR used an inflatable litter to pass him hand-to-hand to the wheeled litter on the trail above, then wheeled ~1.5 miles to the road; CareFlight 4 flew him to Grand Junction; he recovered fully with no lasting injuries.
responding_agency: Crested Butte SAR + Crested Butte Fire/EMS + Mt. Crested Butte police + CareFlight 4
notes: Second same-day OBJ incident: Cole Conger of Fort Collins landed badly off the big drop and hurt his back; hospital x-rays showed no lasting injury. The Saturday steep-creek race was cancelled. Resolves the run-48 pending date lead; date exact (Friday, June 7, 2024 per CBN).
